name: exploratory-thread-axis-analytic-protocol-v1
purpose: Falsification against independently constructed polygonal cylindrical surfaces, not calibration for threaded solids or manufacturing acceptance.
truthDefinition: Each generated polygonal prism has known section centre center + slope * (z - 5). Offset is distance between the two centres at z=5. Angle is the angle between their direction vectors (slope_x,slope_y,1). The polygon is inscribed, so this truth describes its symmetry axis, not a circular exact solid.
decisionRule: Report individual numeric errors and availability. Neither success nor failure of these finite cases is a calibrated bound or an assembly verdict. An absent estimate is not a numeric success. Always NOT_RUN for actual coaxiality verification.
